label: Mono laser all-in-one, wired + wireless
description: 36 ppm monochrome all-in-one with 10/100Base-TX Ethernet plus 802.11b/g/n 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Either path can carry print jobs, and both can be up simultaneously.
notes: Wired (10/100) and wireless (2.4 GHz only) together. No PoE. Wireless is 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n, so it cannot join a 5 GHz-only SSID.
